verification.reason: Threshold is selected on validation set using Youden's J statistic, but there is NO separate test set. The project evaluates on the same validation set used for threshold selection. This is a development/validation setup, not a proper test set evaluation.

critical_issue.implication: Reported metrics are validation metrics, not test metrics. No untouched test set exists for final evaluation.

guards.note: Guards needed to prevent test data usage in threshold selection. More critically, a separate test set needs to be created.
